description: This PHP class 'Filter' manages user, donor, promoter, matcher, and tester filtering logic, including database interactions for retrieving and setting filter criteria, and generating SQL queries for different user roles within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for managing complex user, donor, promoter, matcher, and tester filters, including database interactions and SQL query generation within the Goteo project.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a filter by ID, including related projects, calls, nodes, matchers, SDGs, footprints, and social commitments.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all filters from the database.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of filters with optional pagination and count.

methods.name: getFilterLocation
methods.description: Returns the FilterLocation object associated with this filter.

methods.name: getFilterProject
methods.description: Retrieves projects associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterCall
methods.description: Retrieves calls associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterNode
methods.description: Retrieves nodes associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves matchers associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterSDG
methods.description: Retrieves SDGs associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves footprints associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterSocialCommitments
methods.description: Retrieves social commitments associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: setFilterProjects
methods.description: Sets the projects for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterCalls
methods.description: Sets the calls for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterNodes
methods.description: Sets the nodes for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterMatcher
methods.description: Sets the matchers for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterSDG
methods.description: Sets the SDGs for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterFootprint
methods.description: Sets the footprints for this filter in the database.

methods.name: setFilterSocialCommitment
methods.description: Sets social commitments for this filter in the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the filter's data before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the filter to the database, including related entities.

methods.name: isUsed
methods.description: Checks if the filter is referenced by other database entities.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getUsersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for user retrieval based on the filter.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves donors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getDonorsCount
methods.description: Counts donors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for donor retrieval.

methods.name: getNoDonors
methods.description: Retrieves users who are not donors based on the filter.

methods.name: getNoDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for non-donor user retrieval.

methods.name: getPromoters
methods.description: Retrieves promoters based on the filter.

methods.name: getPromotersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for promoter retrieval.

methods.name: getMatchers
methods.description: Retrieves matchers based on the filter.

methods.name: getMatchersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for matcher retrieval.

methods.name: getTesters
methods.description: Retrieves testers based on the filter.

methods.name: getTestersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for tester retrieval.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Returns filtered users, donors, promoters, matchers, or testers based on role.

methods.name: getFilteredSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL query and parameters for the filtered role.

search-terms: user, donor, promoter, matcher, tester filters
